steps.code:
# Parse all notes: extract date and habit values.
import re

# Get habit order from first note
first_content = all_notes[0]['content']
habit_lines = [line for line in first_content.splitlines() if ': yes' in line or ': no' in line]
habits = [line.split(':')[0].strip() for line in habit_lines]
print("Habits in order:", habits)

# Parse each note
rows = []
for note in all_notes:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    date = m.group(1)
    # Parse content lines
    content_lines = [line for line in note['content'].splitlines() if ': yes' in line or ': no' in line]
    # Build dict habit->value
    values = {}
    for line in content_lines:
        habit, val = line.split(':', 1)
        values[habit.strip()] = val.strip()
    # Build row in habit order
    row = [date] + [values[h] for h in habits]
    rows.append(row)

# Sort by date ascending
rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])
print("Number of rows:", len(rows))
print("First row:", rows[0])
print("Last row:", rows[-1])
